mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying 72-degree temperatures with clear skies at the Reddan Soccer Park under a waning gibbous moon.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month, highlighting that 1 in 8 residents face food insecurity. Additionally, traffic on Highway M will see flagging for utility work starting Monday and Tuesday.

There is a lot happening today, including the Kids Triathlon at the high school, live music at Bailey's Run, and tunes at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, consider catching a yoga class at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy update from last week, on August 21, a driver was stopped for expired registration and subsequently cited for possession of marijuana.
Today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit to enjoy a scoop of this local favorite.
